title: Simultaneous local expressions in finite generating sections
statement: Let $R$ be a ring sheaf on a small site $(C,J)$, let $M$ be an $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $\sigma$ be a finite family of global generating sections, let $U\in C$, and let $(s_t)$ be a finite family in $M(U)$. There exists one covering sieve $S\in J(U)$ such that for every $a:V\to U$ in $S$ and every $t$, there are coefficients $c_i\in R(V)$ with $M(a)(s_t)=\sum_i c_i\sigma_i(V)$. The empty families are included.

proof.text: Lift the finitely many s_t simultaneously through the free-module epimorphism σ.π, using [lem-weil-pbc-finite-sections-epi-lift]. On the cover express each lifted free section in its coordinate basis; applying σ.π expresses the section in the generator values. The freeHomEquiv and unitHomEquiv equations identify each basis image.

theorem exists_cover_linearCombination_generators
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}} (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (σ : M.GeneratingSections) [Fintype σ.I] (U : C)
    {T : Type u} [Finite T] (s : T → M.val.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ S ∈ J U, ∀ (V : C) (a : V ⟶ U), S a →
      ∀ j, ∃ c : σ.I → R.obj.obj (op V),
        M.val.map a.op (s j) = ∑ i, c i • (show M.val.obj (op V) from (σ.s i).val (op V))
